comparison.objective: Unhook or release an air-fryer basket and place it on a heat-proof mat without touching hot surfaces.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate a handle and retention mechanism, clear hooks or a drawer, then carry and release a rigid basket.
comparison.success_condition: Basket cleared from its retention, placed flat and still on the mat, released, with no hot contact, bypass, or drop.
comparison.reason: Both involve container transport and guarded release, but this record tests retention-mechanism operation and hot-surface avoidance. It lacks moving-target classification, articulated-flap avoidance, loose-content retention, and untouched pass-through items.
